Bug_Title: SQL: Method attempts to access a result set field with index 0 (SQL_BAD_RESULTSET_ACCESS)
Bug_Details:
A call to getXXX or updateXXX methods of a result set was made where the
field index is 0. As ResultSet fields start at index 1, this is always a mistake.
Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs when attempting to access a ResultSet field using index 0. In SQL, ResultSet fields start from index 1.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the showBug method is called with a mockResultSet. The mockResultSet throws a SQLException when the getString method is called with an index of 0, which is the buggy behavior in the original code.
